verdict.rationale: Carta's API explicitly supports creating draft option grants ('a draft option grant is either still being finalized or that has not yet received board consent and approval'), which matches the queued-for-approval workflow, and this is reachable programmatically via OAuth-authenticated API calls or the documented Claude MCP integration. However, evidence doesn't show an agent-specific workflow or explicit board-approval-routing mechanics beyond the draft state description. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the board approval/consent workflow triggered from a draft, confirmation that MCP/agent tools expose the draft-creation endpoint (vs just read access), and independent/hands-on validation of this flow.
